sf-alternate.description: Zigzag / alternating two-column layout. Even children align image-left/text-right; odd children flip. Collapses to a single column below the breakpoint.

sf-bento.description: Auto-fill bento grid for card dashboards. Children span 1 column by default; use span modifiers (sf-bento-wide, sf-bento-tall, sf-bento-full, sf-bento-featured) to break the grid.

sf-bento--2.description: Bento grid variant with a 2-column base layout.

sf-bento--3.description: Bento grid variant with a 3-column base layout.

sf-bento--6.description: Bento grid variant with a 6-column base layout.

sf-bento--row-compact.description: Bento grid variant with shorter default row height.

sf-bento--row-tall.description: Bento grid variant with taller default row height.

sf-bento-featured.description: Span modifier for a bento item: takes up 2×2 cells (featured hero placement).

sf-bento-full.description: Span modifier for a bento item: stretches across all columns (full-width banner).

sf-bento-tall.description: Span modifier for a bento item: doubles the row height (tall card).

sf-bento-wide.description: Span modifier for a bento item: spans 2 columns (wide card).

sf-bg-layer.description: Background layer — absolutely-positioned cover media that sits behind a parent's content. The parent is auto-promoted to a positioned, isolated stacking context via :has(), so .sf-bg-layer composes natively under .sf-scrim (background → scrim gradient → content). Works as a bare or as a wrapper with a nested > img / > video / > picture.

sf-box.description: Minimal padding container that applies --sf-component-pad on all sides. The simplest layout primitive for adding breathing room.

sf-breakout.description: Breaks a child element out of a parent sf-content-grid, spanning full bleed (or a named grid area) regardless of the parent column. Useful for full-width sections inside constrained prose.

sf-btn.description: Interactive call-to-action button. Apply to <button> or <a>. Intrinsic width by default; owns its own styling (excluded from the classless <button> look). Three orthogonal axes — colour family, style treatment (fill/--soft/--outline), gradient — plus a size modifier.

sf-btn--action.description: Button in the action colour family (same as the unmodified default, named explicitly).

sf-btn--base.description: Button in the base (surface-neutral) colour family.

sf-btn--block-cq.description: Full-width button only inside a query container narrower than 20rem; intrinsic otherwise.

sf-btn--danger.description: Button in the danger (destructive) colour family.

sf-btn--gradient.description: Gradient axis: paints the fill (or, with --outline, the border ring) with the family's --sf-gradient-* token. Core-4 brand families (primary/secondary/tertiary/action); solid no-op for other families. Composes with any colour family.

sf-btn--info.description: Button in the info colour family.

sf-btn--neutral.description: Button in the neutral colour family.

sf-btn--outline.description: Outlined button (coloured border/text, transparent fill) that fills with the family colour on hover. Composes with any colour family.

sf-btn--primary.description: Button in the primary brand colour family.

sf-btn--secondary.description: Button in the secondary brand colour family.

sf-btn--soft.description: Soft tonal-fill button: a light wash of the family colour (subtle at rest, muted on hover), coloured text, no border. Lower-emphasis than the solid fill. Composes with any colour family.

sf-btn--success.description: Button in the success (positive) colour family.

sf-btn--tertiary.description: Button in the tertiary brand colour family.

sf-btn--warning.description: Button in the warning (caution) colour family.

sf-card.description: Padded content container with optional __header/__body/__footer and __media/__avatar/__title subcomponents. Uses concentric radius math so inner corners stay proportional.

sf-card__avatar.description: Circular avatar image inside a card, sized via --sf-card-avatar-size.

sf-card__footer.description: Card footer slot with a top divider.

sf-card__header.description: Card header slot with a bottom divider.

sf-card__media.description: Full-width cover image/video for a card, cropped to --sf-card-media-ratio (16/9 by default).

sf-card--bordered.description: Flat, outlined card: keeps the border, drops the shadow.

sf-card--elevated.description: Floating card: hides the border, applies a larger shadow.

sf-card--interactive.description: Adds a pointer cursor and a shadow/translate lift on hover or keyboard focus. Pair with .sf-clickable-parent for a fully clickable card. Lift is suppressed under prefers-reduced-motion.

sf-center.description: Centers children both horizontally and vertically using flexbox. Optionally add sf-center--intrinsic to size the container to its content.

sf-center--intrinsic.description: Modifier for sf-center: constrains the container to the natural width of its children (no stretching to fill available space).

sf-clickable-parent.description: Makes the entire card or list-item clickable via an absolutely-positioned child overlay link. Apply to the container; place sf-clickable-parent__overlay on the <a>.

sf-clickable-parent__overlay.description: The full-bleed overlay link inside an sf-clickable-parent. Stretches to cover the parent and uses pointer-events to let interactive children keep their own clicks.

sf-cluster.description: Flex-wrap row of variable-width items with automatic gap. Children wrap when the container is too narrow. Use for tag lists, button groups, and icon rows.

sf-cluster--2xl.description: Cluster variant with 2xl gap between items.

sf-cluster--between.description: Cluster variant that distributes items with space-between alignment.

sf-cluster--center.description: Cluster variant that centers the item row horizontally.

sf-cluster--end.description: Cluster variant that aligns items to the inline end (right in LTR).

sf-cluster--l.description: Cluster variant with large (l) gap between items.

sf-cluster--m.description: Cluster variant with medium (m) gap between items.

sf-cluster--no-wrap.description: Cluster variant that prevents item wrapping (single-line row).

sf-cluster--s.description: Cluster variant with small (s) gap between items.

sf-cluster--xl.description: Cluster variant with xl gap between items.

sf-cluster--xs.description: Cluster variant with xs gap between items.

sf-color-pulse.description: Applies a gentle color-pulse animation to draw attention to a dynamic value change (e.g. a counter updating). Scoped to users who have not requested reduced motion.

sf-container.description: Max-width page container, centered with auto side gutters. Establishes a named inline-size container (cq-container) for container queries. Default width is --sf-container-m.

sf-container--full.description: Container variant that spans the full viewport width (no max-width cap).

sf-container--narrow.description: Container variant with a narrower max-width (--sf-container-s). Use for single-column prose and forms.

sf-container--prose.description: Container variant with a prose-optimised max-width (--sf-container-prose). Ideal for long-form reading content.

sf-container--wide.description: Container variant with a wider max-width (--sf-container-l). Use for dashboards and wide media.

sf-content-grid.description: Holy-grail content grid with named areas: full-bleed, popout, and content columns. Use sf-breakout on children to escape the content column.

sf-cover.description: Vertically stretches to at least a viewport height with a centered element (sf-cover__center). Typical use: hero sections.

sf-cover__center.description: The centered focal element inside an sf-cover. Stays vertically centered even when the cover content is shorter than the viewport.

sf-cover--max.description: Cover variant that uses a max-height instead of min-height for the viewport constraint.

sf-cover--min.description: Cover variant that reduces the minimum height to half a viewport.

sf-cover--padding-l.description: Cover variant with large vertical padding above and below the centered content.

sf-cover--padding-s.description: Cover variant with small vertical padding above and below the centered content.

sf-cq.description: Assigns an inline-size container context to any element. Children can then use @container rules or container-query-aware tokens.

sf-divide.description: Rules between direct children (a border on each child after the first), reusing .sf-divider's tokens — no per-gap markup needed.

sf-divide--vertical.description: Vertical rules between direct children (inline-start borders), for row/horizontal layouts.

sf-divider.description: Horizontal rule (divider line). Uses --sf-divider-* tokens for color, width, and style. Modifiers change dash style or orientation.

sf-divider--dashed.description: Divider variant with a dashed stroke.

sf-divider--dotted.description: Divider variant with a dotted stroke.

sf-divider--gradient.description: Divider variant rendered as a gradient that fades to transparent at both ends.

sf-divider--soft.description: Divider variant with reduced opacity (subtle separator).

sf-divider--strong.description: Divider variant with stronger/darker color for a more prominent separator.

sf-divider--vertical.description: Divider variant rendered as a vertical line. Use inside flex or grid containers.

sf-drop-shadow-l.description: Large filter drop-shadow — follows the element's alpha shape (--sf-drop-shadow-l).

sf-drop-shadow-m.description: Medium filter drop-shadow — follows the element's alpha shape (--sf-drop-shadow-m).

sf-drop-shadow-s.description: Small filter drop-shadow — follows the element's alpha shape (--sf-drop-shadow-s).

sf-drop-shadow-xl.description: Extra-large filter drop-shadow — follows the element's alpha shape (--sf-drop-shadow-xl).

sf-drop-shadow-xs.description: Extra-small filter drop-shadow — follows the element's alpha shape (--sf-drop-shadow-xs).

sf-entrance--fade.description: Scroll-driven entrance: element fades in as it enters the viewport. Animation tied to scroll progress via animation-timeline.

sf-entrance--fade-down.description: Scroll-driven entrance: element fades in while moving downward into position.

sf-entrance--fade-left.description: Scroll-driven entrance: element fades in while moving from the right toward the left.

sf-entrance--fade-right.description: Scroll-driven entrance: element fades in while moving from the left toward the right.

sf-entrance--fade-up.description: Scroll-driven entrance: element fades in while moving upward into position.

sf-entrance--scale-up.description: Scroll-driven entrance: element fades in while scaling up from a slightly smaller size.

sf-equal.description: Flowing CSS multi-column layout (not a grid) — content distributes across columns like a newspaper instead of sitting in fixed cells. Reach for .sf-grid/.sf-grid--fit for discrete grid cells instead.

sf-equal-height.description: Forces all flex children to equal height (align-items: stretch). Use on a flex row to make cards in a grid share the tallest card's height.

sf-exit--fade.description: Scroll-out exit animation: fades the element out in place (sf-fade-out).

sf-exit--fade-down.description: Scroll-out exit animation: fades out while sliding downward (sf-slide-out-down).

sf-exit--fade-left.description: Scroll-out exit animation: fades out while sliding to the left (sf-slide-out-left).

sf-exit--fade-right.description: Scroll-out exit animation: fades out while sliding to the right (sf-slide-out-right).

sf-exit--fade-up.description: Scroll-out exit animation: fades out while sliding upward (sf-slide-out-up).

sf-exit--scale-down.description: Scroll-out exit animation: fades out while shrinking (sf-scale-down).

sf-fade-in.description: One-shot fade-in animation (opacity 0 → 1). Scoped to no-preference so it stops automatically for reduced-motion users.

sf-fade-out.description: One-shot fade-out animation (opacity 1 → 0). Scoped to no-preference.

sf-flow.description: Applies --sf-flow-space as margin-block-start to all direct children except the first. Establishes consistent vertical rhythm in prose-like containers.

sf-fluid-cq.description: .sf-fluid-cq: opt a subtree into a CONTAINER-relative fluid scale (issue #497).

sf-focus-parent.description: Forwards focus-visible styling to this container when any descendant is keyboard-focused. Useful for custom controls that wrap a visually-hidden <input>.

sf-focus-shadow.description: Applies the standard focus ring as a box-shadow to any element. Use on custom controls where the native :focus-visible ring doesn't render correctly.

sf-frame.description: Aspect-ratio container for media (images, video, maps). Children fill and cover the fixed-ratio box. Default ratio is 16:9.

sf-frame--3-2.description: Frame variant locked to a 3:2 aspect ratio.

sf-frame--4-3.description: Frame variant locked to a 4:3 aspect ratio.

sf-frame--cinema.description: Frame variant locked to a cinematic 21:9 aspect ratio.

sf-frame--golden.description: Frame variant locked to the golden ratio (1.618:1).

sf-frame--portrait.description: Frame variant locked to a portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.

sf-frame--square.description: Frame variant locked to a square 1:1 aspect ratio.

sf-frame--video.description: Frame variant locked to the standard 16:9 video aspect ratio.

sf-full-bleed.description: Forces an element to span the full viewport width, breaking out of any centered container. Use for full-bleed images and section backgrounds.

sf-gap.description: Injects the default --sf-gap into an existing flex or grid container without imposing display:flex itself. Use when the parent is already a flex or grid.

sf-gap--2xl.description: Gap injection variant with 2xl gap value.

sf-gap--l.description: Gap injection variant with large (l) gap value.

sf-gap--m.description: Gap injection variant with medium (m) gap value.

sf-gap--s.description: Gap injection variant with small (s) gap value.

sf-gap--xl.description: Gap injection variant with xl gap value.

sf-gap--xs.description: Gap injection variant with xs gap value.

sf-grid.description: Auto-fill CSS grid. Columns are sized with RAM pattern (Repeat, Auto-fill, Minmax) and wrap automatically. Default column min-width is --sf-grid-min-col.

sf-grid--2xl.description: Grid variant with a 2xl minimum column width.

sf-grid--dense.description: Grid variant with grid-auto-flow: dense, allowing the grid to fill holes created by span modifiers.

sf-grid--fit.description: Grid variant that switches from auto-fill to auto-fit, collapsing empty columns.

sf-grid--l.description: Grid variant with a large (l) minimum column width.

sf-grid--m.description: Grid variant with a medium (m) minimum column width.

sf-grid--s.description: Grid variant with a small (s) minimum column width.

sf-grid--xl.description: Grid variant with an xl minimum column width.

sf-grid--xs.description: Grid variant with an xs minimum column width.

sf-grid-cols-1.description: Single-column layout (forces all children to one column).

sf-grid-cols-1-2.description: Two-column ratio grid: first child takes 1fr, second takes 2fr. Container-query responsive.

sf-grid-cols-1-3.description: Two-column ratio grid: first child takes 1fr, second takes 3fr. Container-query responsive.

sf-grid-cols-2.description: Responsive 2-column fixed grid. Uses container queries to collapse to one column on narrow containers.

sf-grid-cols-2-1.description: Two-column ratio grid: first child takes 2fr, second takes 1fr. Container-query responsive.

sf-grid-cols-3.description: Responsive 3-column fixed grid. Collapses progressively on narrow containers.

sf-grid-cols-3-1.description: Two-column ratio grid: first child takes 3fr, second takes 1fr. Container-query responsive.

sf-grid-cols-4.description: Responsive 4-column fixed grid. Collapses progressively on narrow containers.

sf-grid-cols-6.description: Responsive 6-column fixed grid. Collapses progressively on narrow containers.

sf-grid-flex.description: Flexbox alternative to .sf-grid for item counts that don't divide evenly: leftover last-row items stretch to fill the row by default, or stay fixed-width and centered with --center.

sf-grid-flex--2xl.description: Grid-flex variant with a 2xl minimum item width.

sf-grid-flex--center.description: Grid-flex variant that keeps last-row leftover items fixed-width and centered instead of stretching.

sf-grid-flex--l.description: Grid-flex variant with a large (l) minimum item width.

sf-grid-flex--m.description: Grid-flex variant with a medium (m) minimum item width.

sf-grid-flex--s.description: Grid-flex variant with a small (s) minimum item width.

sf-grid-flex--xl.description: Grid-flex variant with an xl minimum item width.

sf-grid-flex--xs.description: Grid-flex variant with an xs minimum item width.

sf-h1.description: Applies h1-level typography (size, line-height, weight, tracking, max-width) to any element without changing its semantic level.

sf-h2.description: Applies h2-level typography to any element without changing its semantic level.

sf-h3.description: Applies h3-level typography to any element without changing its semantic level.

sf-h4.description: Applies h4-level typography to any element without changing its semantic level.

sf-h5.description: Applies h5-level typography to any element without changing its semantic level.

sf-h6.description: Applies h6-level typography to any element without changing its semantic level.

sf-header--l.description: Header block padding at the l step (--sf-space-l).

sf-header--m.description: Header block padding at the m step (--sf-space-m).

sf-header--s.description: Header block padding at the s step (--sf-space-s).

sf-header--xl.description: Header block padding at the xl step (--sf-space-xl).

sf-header--xs.description: Header block padding at the xs step (--sf-space-xs).

sf-hover-float.description: Hover-triggered transform: translates the element up slightly on hover.

sf-hover-grow.description: Hover-triggered transform: scales the element up slightly on hover.

sf-hover-shrink.description: Hover-triggered transform: scales the element down slightly on hover.

sf-hover-sink.description: Hover-triggered transform: translates the element down slightly on hover.

sf-hover-slide-end.description: Hover-triggered transform: translates the element toward the inline-end on hover.

sf-hover-slide-start.description: Hover-triggered transform: translates the element toward the inline-start on hover.

sf-icon.description: Inline icon sizing primitive. Sets width and height to --sf-icon-m via em-based tokens so the icon scales with the surrounding text.

sf-icon--boxed.description: Icon variant with a square bordered box background. Useful for standalone icon buttons and feature icons.

sf-icon--m.description: Icon variant sized to --sf-icon-m (medium, same as base sf-icon).

sf-imposter.description: Absolutely positions an element at the center of its nearest positioned ancestor. Use for overlays, badges, and floating labels.

sf-imposter--contain.description: Imposter variant that clamps the element within the bounds of its parent using overflow:hidden on the parent.

sf-imposter--fixed.description: Imposter variant that uses position:fixed instead of absolute. Use for viewport-level overlays and modals.

sf-invisible.description: Visibility helper (optional/utilities.css) — hides the element visually but keeps it in the layout and accessibility tree (visibility: hidden). Not a runtime state: no JS/ARIA condition of its own.

sf-is-disabled.description: Disabled state — dims the element (--sf-opacity-disabled), removes pointer events, and sets cursor: not-allowed. Inherited by child elements that re-enable pointer events.

sf-is-error.description: Error state — general (not form-field-specific) negative feedback. Applies danger color tokens to indicate a validation failure or system error. Visual styling is identical to sf-is-invalid.

sf-is-hidden-if-empty.description: Hides the element when it has no child nodes (:empty). An action-on-state helper (the name states the behaviour) for dynamic lists or containers that may render empty.

sf-is-highlighted.description: Highlighted state — applies a highlight background. Useful for search result highlighting and keyboard-navigated lists.

sf-is-info.description: Info status state — applies info color tokens. Use for neutral informational messages and hints.

sf-is-invalid.description: Invalid state — applies danger color tokens to form fields with validation failures. Identical visual output to sf-is-error; the name signals form-field context.

sf-is-loading.description: Loading state — hides the element's text (color: transparent), removes pointer events, and renders a spinner via ::after. Use for buttons and containers awaiting async results.

sf-is-selected.description: Selected state — marks an item as selected in a list, table row, or grid cell. Visual specifics (background, border) are applied by component styles.

sf-is-shimmer.description: Shimmer loading placeholder state. Applies a shimmer animation over the element to indicate that content is loading. Works on both img and non-media elements. (Renamed from .sf-is-skeleton so "skeleton" refers only to the planned .sf-skeleton component.)

sf-is-success.description: Success status state — applies success color tokens. Use for confirmation messages, completed form steps, and positive feedback.

sf-is-valid.description: Valid state — applies success color tokens to form fields that have passed validation. Visual styling is identical to sf-is-success; the name signals form-field context.

sf-is-warning.description: Warning status state — applies warning color tokens. Use for cautionary messages and non-critical alerts.

sf-line-clamp-2.description: Clamps text to 2 lines with an ellipsis. Applies -webkit-line-clamp: 2.

sf-line-clamp-3.description: Clamps text to 3 lines with an ellipsis. Applies -webkit-line-clamp: 3.

sf-line-clamp-N.description: Clamps text to a custom N lines. Set --sf-line-clamp on the element to control the number of visible lines.

sf-link--reverse.description: Link color modifier: reverses the default link color to work on dark/inverted backgrounds. Sets color to --sf-color-text--inverse.

sf-link--subtle.description: Link color modifier: renders the link in the body text color instead of the default action color. Underline still indicates the link on hover.

sf-link-external.description: Automatically appends an external-link icon (via ::after content) to indicate the link opens in a new tab or goes to an external domain.

sf-list-none.description: Drops marker + inline start-padding in one class, on any <ul>/<ol> (or element with list-style applied).

sf-live-validate.description: Scopes native constraint-validation feedback to this subtree: within it, :user-invalid/:user-valid on input/select/textarea drive --sf-field-border-color (the same token .sf-is-invalid/.sf-is-valid set explicitly). Apply to a <form> or <fieldset>. Off by default so a still-empty required field isn't marked invalid before a submit is attempted.

sf-marker--action.description: Colours list ::markers with the action colour.

sf-marker--primary.description: Colours list ::markers with the primary brand colour.

sf-marker--secondary.description: Colours list ::markers with the secondary brand colour.

sf-marker--tertiary.description: Colours list ::markers with the tertiary brand colour.

sf-no-tap-highlight.description: Removes the mobile tap highlight color (-webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent). Use on interactive elements with a custom active state.

sf-not-prose.description: Opt-out of sf-prose typography styles within a prose block. Apply to an element that should keep default browser or component styles.

sf-overflow-fade.description: Adds a gradient fade at the inline-end of an overflowing element to hint at hidden content. Use inside sf-reel or any scroll container.

sf-overflow-fade--block.description: Overflow fade variant: fades both the top and bottom edges simultaneously (block axis).

sf-overflow-fade--bottom.description: Overflow fade variant: fades the bottom (block-end) edge.

sf-overflow-fade--inline.description: Overflow fade variant: fades both the left and right edges simultaneously (inline axis).

sf-overflow-fade--left.description: Overflow fade variant: fades the left (inline-start) edge.

sf-overflow-fade--right.description: Overflow fade variant: fades the right (inline-end) edge. Explicit alias for the default sf-overflow-fade behaviour.

sf-overflow-fade--top.description: Overflow fade variant: fades the top (block-start) edge.

sf-overlay.description: Overlay layout helper — absolutely fills its positioned parent (`position: absolute; inset: 0`) for overlays, backdrops, and media scrims.

sf-place-center.description: Box-neutral centring primitive: display:grid + place-items:center centres an element's content on both axes without adopting cluster/stack/imposter semantics. Unlike sf-center (which centres itself), this centres the content; give the box a height for block-axis centring. The named form of the display:grid; place-items:center idiom.

sf-prose.description: Opinionated typographic defaults for long-form content: heading hierarchy, paragraph spacing, blockquote, code, and list styling. Override with sf-not-prose.

sf-reel.description: Horizontally scrollable row of fixed-height items with snap scrolling. Children don't shrink below their intrinsic width, creating a card carousel effect.

sf-render-lazy.description: Defers rendering of off-screen content via content-visibility: auto. The browser skips layout+paint for content outside the viewport, improving LCP for long pages.

sf-scale-down.description: One-shot scale-down animation (element shrinks from full size). Scoped to no-preference.

sf-scale-up.description: One-shot scale-up animation (element grows from smaller size). Scoped to no-preference.

sf-scrim.description: Overlay container with a gradient darkening scrim behind text placed on an image or colored background.

sf-scrim__content.description: Content area inside an sf-scrim. Positioned above the gradient overlay layer.

sf-scrim--bottom.description: Scrim variant with the gradient emanating from the bottom edge (bottom-to-top fade).

sf-scrim--full.description: Scrim variant that covers the entire surface with a uniform translucent overlay.

sf-scrim--top.description: Scrim variant with the gradient emanating from the top edge (top-to-bottom fade).

sf-scroll-shadow.description: Adds inset box-shadows at the top and bottom of a scrollable container to indicate hidden overflow above or below.

sf-scroll-snap.description: Enables CSS scroll-snap-type: x mandatory on a horizontal scroll container. Children should have scroll-snap-align.

sf-section.description: Full-width page section with vertical padding (--sf-section-pad-default). Use to create visually distinct content bands.

sf-section--collapse.description: Section variant that removes vertical padding (zero-padding section for adjacent same-color blocks).

sf-section--guttered.description: Adds horizontal page gutters directly to a section — use when you want to skip a separate .sf-container wrapper (gutterless layout inside section). Neutralises container gutter to prevent double padding.

sf-section--l.description: Section variant with large (l) vertical padding.

sf-section--m.description: Section variant with medium (m) vertical padding.

sf-section--s.description: Section variant with small (s) vertical padding.

sf-section--xl.description: Section variant with xl vertical padding.

sf-section--xs.description: Section variant with xs vertical padding.

sf-section-group.description: Groups adjacent sf-section elements so their combined padding collapses correctly at the top and bottom edges.

sf-selection--alt.description: Overrides the ::selection custom properties (core/base.css) on the element and its descendants, for surfaces where the default selection colours land with poor contrast (e.g. a dark card on a light page). Backed by --sf-color-selection-*--alt (core/tokens.css).

sf-sidebar.description: Two-column sidebar layout: first child is the sidebar, second child is main content. The sidebar collapses below the breakpoint (--sf-sidebar-min-width). Default sidebar on the left.

sf-sidebar--narrow.description: Sidebar variant with a narrower sidebar column.

sf-sidebar--right.description: Sidebar variant with the sidebar on the right (second child becomes the sidebar).

sf-sidebar--wide.description: Sidebar variant with a wider sidebar column.

sf-slide-in-down.description: One-shot slide-in-from-above animation. Scoped to no-preference.

sf-slide-in-left.description: One-shot slide-in-from-right animation (slides to the left). Scoped to no-preference.

sf-slide-in-right.description: One-shot slide-in-from-left animation (slides to the right). Scoped to no-preference.

sf-slide-in-up.description: One-shot slide-in-from-below animation. Scoped to no-preference.

sf-stack.description: Flex column with even vertical spacing between children (--sf-stack-gap). Stacking context for vertical rhythm.

sf-stack--2xl.description: Stack variant with 2xl gap between children.

sf-stack--center.description: Stack variant that centers children on the cross axis.

sf-stack--end.description: Stack variant that aligns children to the cross-axis end (right in LTR).

sf-stack--l.description: Stack variant with large (l) gap between children.

sf-stack--m.description: Stack variant with medium (m) gap between children.

sf-stack--s.description: Stack variant with small (s) gap between children.

sf-stack--stretch.description: Stack variant that stretches children to fill the full available width.

sf-stack--xl.description: Stack variant with xl gap between children.

sf-stack--xs.description: Stack variant with xs gap between children.

sf-stagger.description: Stagger — choreography, not the animation itself. Put .sf-stagger on a PARENT; every direct child gets an incrementing animation-delay so a time-based entrance (.sf-fade-in / .sf-slide-in-*) plays in sequence.

sf-sticky.description: position: sticky pinned at the header-aware --sf-sticky-offset.

sf-sticky--l.description: Sticky positioning with an extra large gap (--sf-space-l) above the header-aware offset.

sf-sticky--m.description: Sticky positioning with an extra medium gap (--sf-space-m) above the header-aware offset.

sf-sticky--s.description: Sticky positioning with an extra small gap (--sf-space-s) above the header-aware offset.

sf-subgrid.description: Passes the parent grid columns through to children via subgrid. Place on a grid item that should align its own children to the outer grid columns.

sf-subgrid-rows.description: Passes the parent grid rows through to children via subgrid. Place on a grid item that should align its own children to the outer grid rows.

sf-surface.description: Generic semantic surface: applies --sf-surface-color as the background and automatically sets a contrasting text color. Tone variants (--primary, --action, etc.) activate preset palettes.

sf-surface--action.description: Surface variant using the action color palette (button/CTA primary color).

sf-surface--danger.description: Surface variant using the danger status palette.

sf-surface--info.description: Surface variant using the info status palette.

sf-surface--inverse.description: Surface variant that inverts light/dark, creating an always-dark surface in light mode and always-light in dark mode.

sf-surface--neutral.description: Surface variant using the neutral palette (muted/gray).

sf-surface--primary.description: Surface variant using the primary brand color palette.

sf-surface--secondary.description: Surface variant using the secondary brand color palette.

sf-surface--success.description: Surface variant using the success status palette.

sf-surface--tertiary.description: Surface variant using the tertiary brand color palette.

sf-surface--warning.description: Surface variant using the warning status palette.

sf-surface-bg.description: Named background surface preset (issue #523). Composes the --sf-surface-bg-* token set (see tokens.macros.css) into one reusable, named background: base colour + image/gradient/pattern, sizing, an optional overlay layered above the image, and an optional animation.

sf-switcher.description: Flex layout that switches from a horizontal row to a vertical column when the container is narrower than --sf-switcher-threshold.

sf-switcher--no-wrap.description: Switcher variant that stays horizontal and never wraps (single-line regardless of container width).

sf-switcher--vertical.description: Switcher variant that starts in the vertical (stacked) direction on all sizes.

sf-tabular-nums.description: Forces tabular (monospaced) number rendering. Use on price tables, counters, and anywhere numbers need to align vertically across rows.

sf-text-2xl.description: Applies the 2xl text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-2xs.description: Applies the 2xs text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-3xl.description: Applies the 3xl text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-4xl.description: Applies the 4xl text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-gradient.description: Applies a brand gradient to inline text. Sets the background to the gradient, clips it to the text, and makes the text color transparent.

sf-text-l.description: Applies the l text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-m.description: Applies the m (body) text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-protect.description: Wraps text in a translucent dark gradient overlay to ensure legibility when placed over a light or variable background image.

sf-text-s.description: Applies the s text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-xl.description: Applies the xl text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-text-xs.description: Applies the xs text-size role: font-size, line-height, font-weight, letter-spacing, and measure (max-inline-size) in one class.

sf-theme-dark.description: Forces dark colour scheme on the element and its subtree (class alias of [data-theme="dark"]).

sf-theme-light.description: Forces light colour scheme on the element and its subtree (class alias of [data-theme="light"]).

sf-theme-transition.description: Opt-in animated light/dark theme crossfade. Apply to <html> (or a subtree) so color tokens transition smoothly when [data-theme] changes. Duration controlled by --sf-theme-transition-duration.

sf-touch-target.description: .sf-touch-target — the explicit opt-IN counterpart to the class-less floor above.

sf-truncate.description: Single-line text overflow with ellipsis. Equivalent to the classic text-overflow: ellipsis trio (white-space nowrap, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis).

sf-visible.description: Visibility helper (optional/utilities.css) — forces the element to be visible (visibility: visible). Use to un-hide an element that inherited visibility: hidden from a parent.

sf-width-auto.description: Intrinsic auto width (inline-size:auto) — sizes to the box’s normal layout.

sf-width-fit.description: Width sized to its own content (fit-content).

sf-width-max.description: Widest content-driven width (max-content) — grows to full intrinsic width, no wrapping.

sf-width-min.description: Narrowest content-driven width (min-content) — shrinks to the longest unbreakable content.
